shots.name: island-sculpt
shots.description: Same coast after an Island stamp and a Gulf carve (journal: 2 ops), re-framed on the sculpted terrain

notes: Meshes are built by the same TileManager, PlanetField and meshers the viewport uses.
Shading is an independent CPU reimplementation of the viewport shaders (terrain palette + Beer-Lambert water).
No textures, no post-processing, no screenshots of the browser build.
